q1_issues.issue: (In sk_huddle_1 blanket) uses a bare class symbol for the episodic bare plural "blankets", and (From sk_protect_1 cold) uses one for the definite "the cold"; bare class symbols are reserved for non-specific / generic objects, and an episodic bare plural takes a group witness.
The huddling is given two Agent atoms on one event (collective), but a coordinated NP is distributive by default — collective needs a reciprocal/aggregate predicate or a bare "together / jointly".

"many houses" is recorded as (CardinalityPhrase sk_house_1 "many"), but "many" is listed among the proportion words that set strength (0.7) with a QuantifierPhrase companion and is not in the vague-count lexicon (a few / several / a handful / dozens / scores / hundreds).

q2_gaps: a nominalized adjective used as a referring NP ("the homeless") — no rule for typing such a referent or for its group's member kind

a coordinated NP as the object of an adjective's PP complement ("packed with crying children and the homeless") — whether to duplicate the reified state per conjunct or stack two With atoms on one state is unaddressed
the implicit subject of a purpose infinitive ("to protect them") — the controller-copying rule is stated for control verbs, not for a purpose adjunct, so the protect event is left agentless
notes: Projection out of the say-seal is handled well: the definite "the city squares" and "the homeless" project their group typing and the definitional genus (Inheritance city_square square) projects too, while the indefinite "crying children" stays sealed. The reified "packed" state with a per-member distribution rule for its flat half, and the untensed participial huddle event, both follow the instruction set.
